# Max Care Plan

The Max care plan covers mechanical and electrical faults arising from
normal domestic use. The warranty period is 36 months from the date of
delivery, covering parts and labour.

An engineer visit under the Max plan carries no call-out fee at all — every
visit is free of charge. Approved repairs are completed within 48 hours of
the first visit; where a repair is not economical the unit is replaced with
the same or an equivalent model.

The plan excludes accidental damage, cosmetic wear, and any repair carried
out by anyone other than an approved engineer. Claims are made through the
support portal with the order number to hand.
